author: cli
text: Re-read 2026-08-17 and checked end to end. 'THE label. Header and browser tab both use it' is verified: map_label fills payload['repo'], viz.py:339 substitutes that same value into TITLE_SLOT for <title>, and the template writes it into repoChip. One producer, two surfaces - which is why the tab can no longer claim every map is itsdangerous while the header says otherwise.
